pricing_policy: No list prices. Every engagement is quoted after a scoping call. A brief submitted through scope-project gets a written estimate within three business days.

company.name: ABN Asia
company.summary: ABN Asia builds and reviews software for organisations that cannot afford to find out in production. Founded by people with academic roots and professional experience across the United States, the Netherlands, Hungary, Japan, South Korea, Singapore and Vietnam.
company.commitment: Faster. Better. More reliable. In most cases cheaper.

offers.name: Secure software delivery
offers.summary: Build a system, or audit one, with the security decisions made before the first line of code: a threat model, enforced least privilege, isolation proven by tests, supply-chain discipline, secrets that never reach a repository.
offers.for_who: Teams commissioning software that touches money, health, logistics or communications, and teams inheriting a system nobody can safely change.
deliverables: Written threat model naming each asset, the adversary and the business cost of failure
Architecture and data-flow review with a ranked findings list
Implementation, or a remediation plan the team can execute itself
Test suite covering isolation, authorisation and failure paths
Handover pack: runbook, dependency inventory, incident contacts
good_fit_when: A breach would stop the business, not just annoy it
Several vendors' components meet in one system
A contractor wrote it and left
not_a_fit_when: You need a landing page this week

offers.name: ERP, CRM and operations on Frappe
offers.summary: Implementation, migration and custom apps on Frappe and ERPNext: CRM, Helpdesk, HRMS, accounting, manufacturing, plus the custom DocTypes and workflows the standard modules do not cover.
offers.for_who: Companies replacing spreadsheets and email with one system of record, or running Frappe already and stuck on version drift, customisation debt or performance.
deliverables: Module map and data model for your actual process, not the demo's
Migration from the current tools, with reconciliation counts
Custom apps packaged properly (bench-installable, versioned, tested)
Roles, permissions and audit trail configured and demonstrated
Training for the people who will run it
good_fit_when: You have outgrown a spreadsheet but not outgrown a spreadsheet's price
You want the source and the database, not a rented black box
not_a_fit_when: You need a licensed closed-source ERP with vendor certification

offers.name: AI systems that do a job
offers.summary: Assistants, retrieval over your own documents, document automation and agents with real tool access — built with the evaluation harness first, so quality is measured before it is promised.
offers.for_who: Teams with a specific repetitive decision or document flow, and a person who currently does it by hand.
deliverables: Evaluation set built from your real cases before any model is chosen
Retrieval or agent pipeline with measured accuracy and failure modes
Human-in-the-loop gates on anything that costs money or changes records
Cost and latency budget per task
Runbook for model or vendor changes
good_fit_when: The task has a checkable answer, so quality can be measured
Someone can name the 50 cases the system must get right
not_a_fit_when: The goal is a demo for a board meeting

offers.name: Network and application security
offers.summary: Assessment and hardening of the perimeter and the application: cloud and Kubernetes configuration, exposed services, identity and access, logging and incident readiness.
offers.for_who: Organisations with a public surface they did not design themselves, or a compliance deadline and no map of their own estate.
deliverables: Asset and exposure inventory with evidence
Ranked findings, each with a reproduction and a fix
Hardening applied or specified (firewall, ingress, secrets, IAM)
Detection and alerting for the paths that matter
One-page incident card: who to call, what to do first
good_fit_when: Nobody can say which ports are open to the internet right now
A regulator, a customer or an insurer is asking
not_a_fit_when: You want a penetration test certificate with no remediation

offers.name: Data platforms and reporting
offers.summary: PostgreSQL and Supabase platforms, pipelines, analytics and reporting that reconcile — including high-availability clusters, backup and restore drills, and dashboards the business trusts.
offers.for_who: Teams whose numbers disagree between systems, or whose database is a single server nobody has restored from.
deliverables: Schema and index design with query budgets
Replication, backup and a restore that was actually rehearsed
Pipelines with data-quality checks and failure alerts
Dashboards with definitions written down
Access model: who can read what, enforced in the database
good_fit_when: The backup has never been restored
not_a_fit_when: You need a data warehouse vendor licence

offers.name: Vertical products
offers.summary: Ready-built platforms ABN runs itself, which can be licensed or adapted: education (EduTalk, MiniSchool), operations and field work (GreenOS), real estate (REAL), and the multi-language publishing pipeline behind news.abnasia.org.
offers.for_who: Organisations that want a working product in weeks rather than a build from zero, and can accept its model with adaptations.
deliverables: Product walkthrough against your process
Configuration and branding
Data migration of your first records
Optional custom modules on top
good_fit_when: Your process is close to the product's model
not_a_fit_when: Your process is the differentiator and must be built bespoke

steps: A 30-minute call to challenge the brief
A fixed-scope proposal with price, dates and what is out of scope
Weekly demo of working software, not status reports
Handover with source, database and runbook
contracts: time and materials with a ceiling
how_abn_works.payment: Milestones, invoiced on delivery of each agreed increment.
how_abn_works.nda: Signed before any document is shared, on request.

never: Promise a delivery date before the brief is agreed
Take on work whose failure mode the client cannot survive without saying so
